headline: Virgin Australia Shares Continue to Take Off From Lows, Up 18% This Week - The Bull
summary: Virgin Australia shares rose 6.25% to A$2.55, up 18% since the start of the week. The rebound followed energy prices pulling back from conflict-driven highs.
why: Virgin Australia is a listed airline whose costs are sensitive to jet fuel prices. Lower energy prices typically ease pressure on airline margins.

source.name: The Bull - Independent analysis and news on the global stock markets.

sources.name: The Bull - Independent analysis and news on the global stock markets.

why_moved: Energy prices pulled back from conflict-driven highs, offering relief to the fuel-sensitive carrier and lifting its shares.
